verdict.rationale: Radar's Dashboard shows a dispute/fraud calculation on the Radar page (docs-7), and Fraud Insights charts transaction volume and fraud-rate trends and the attributes that drive them (docs-4, docs-26). That covers the dispute and fraud-rate part of the story. The review queue exists (docs-11, docs-18), but nothing shows it reports workload metrics, and there is no evidence of false-positive rate, approval-rate lift, or board-ready export. Missing for 10: false-positive rate reporting, approval-rate lift metrics, review workload metrics, export or download of reports, independent corroboration.
